acceptance.complete: all cases fully priced and all declared searches complete exactly32 simulations/transitions, immutable input/source joins, no missing/refused/discarded cells; failed attempts retained and do not count
acceptance.defaults: unchanged, optional product mode only if promote and normal delivery/installed/public acceptance
acceptance.harm_definition: harm_s=meanCandidateLoss-meanBaselineLoss=-delta_s; use candidate upper minusbaseline lower for harmupper and candidate lower minusbaseline upper for harmlower
acceptance.inconclusive: all other non-promoting complete results, missingness, inadequate uncertainty or unsupported applicability; do not assert equality
acceptance.nonadoption: a complete qualified experiment showing practical benefit unsupported with evidence of failure: pooled upperbound below practical0.005 OR a simultaneous perstate harm lowerbound>0.01; document narrower descriptive findings
acceptance.promote: all completeness/reference/source/boundary/review gates plus practical absolute and relative reductions, positive pooled lower bound and simultaneous perstate harm upperbounds<=0.01; confidence certifiespositive benefit; practical magnitude criteria are observed point estimates, not a confidence claim of at least0.005 or25percent
acceptance.relative_zero_baseline: relative reduction undefined if baseline pooled loss is zero; promotionfalse, no equalityclaim
acceptance.threshold_rationale: 0.005 is halfonepercent of the shaped-score unit as an engineering minimum benefit, 25percent relative prevents a marginalchange to appreciable baseline loss, perstate0.01 protects against onepercent-score harm. These gate policy adoption, never numericalties.

candidate_selection.trigger: exploratory baseline has at least two positive-loss decisions with selected sampled mean above its exact expectation and selected visits at most ceil(32/K), retaining every counterexample; diagnosis must support allocation/mean optimism rather than objective mismatch
candidate_selection.tuning: one justified mechanism after exploratory diagnosis; no candidate parameter, exploration, selector or budget sweep; candidate semantics/source frozen before deciding execution; all deciding oracle values unavailable to search
candidate_selection.when_no_trigger: evidence-backed no candidate/no change in this domain

domain.constraints_scope: The plain-damage envelope applies to the16 prospective deciding states only; inherited exploratory fields remain literal including the existing shield action.
domain.deciding: sixteen prospective roots, four each in duel ongoing variance, duel kill threshold, two-enemy asymmetric response, and two-enemy area/physical duplicates; frozen source-defined grid, not selected by answers
domain.exploratory: six previously public PR54 roots E1 E2 D1 D2 D3 D4, literal original steps[0].state; all historical deciding material is now exploratory
domain.kind: controlled modeled finite corpus; no population or encounter claim

metrics.primary: equal-case mean exact loss maxQ-Qselected over16cases and4096 independent initialized runs perpolicy; four equal-size families hence equal-family weighting
secondary: every per-state mean loss and adverse difference
root action visits, binary64 sums/means and selected optimism
initialization and elimination arithmetic counters, distinct from simulator transitions
metrics.ties: exact Qref equality defines best set; no epsilon
metrics.unvisited: retained explicitly, never merged physical duplicates

question: Can one root-specific policy reduce first-action exact reference loss with the same 32 completed horizon-one simulator transitions?

resources.execution: existing root-owned serial Windows Job owner
resources.replication_rationale: R4096 chosen beforefirstsearch because Theorem4 simultaneous zero-variance radius sum <=0.00975*B_s permits the0.01 harmguard even for full[0,1] losses; retains useful precision without requiring a huge range-onlyHoeffding corpus. No sequential stopping or data-dependent sample extension.
resources.stopping: whole-report refusal/time/memory/interruption retained; no result-based selective reruns; recovery repair attempts labelled before deciding freeze

rng.independence: distinct independently initialized streams per case/policy/run; labels do not imply identical draw tapes or matched trajectories
rng.scheme: sha256(root-allocation-v1|phase|caseid|policy|runlabel), last eight digest bytes interpreted unsigned big endian, masked to63bits; retain full digest and check no seed collision across planned cells

search.baseline_final: raw mean, then visits, then root encounter insertion order
search.dynamic_legality: existing available physical edges recomputed for each simulation
search.objective: source-order binary64 shaped terminal and ongoing rewards, no stronger-play claim

uncertainty.coverage: total failure probability <=0.05 under declared independence; individual simulation rewards are not decision-loss replications
uncertainty.negative_controls: all adverse cases retained; no post-result variance method switch

per_state.formula: radius_policy=sqrt(2*unbiased_sample_variance(loss)*log(2/delta_event)/4096)+7*B_s*log(2/delta_event)/(3*(4096-1)); mean interval clipped to[0,B_s]; harm interval =candidate interval -baseline interval
per_state.method: Maurer/Pontil2009 Theorem4 empirical Bernstein, applied to final loss normalized by exact Bs
per_state.source_access: Theorem1 and4 inspected original PDFp1-2 before any search; independent review pending

pooled.formula: sqrt(log(2/alpha)*sum_s(B_s^2)/(16^2*4096)) for delta=baseline_loss-candidate_loss, two independent sets perstate

uncertainty.population: Monte Carlo seed variation on these fixed inputs only, treating independent hash-initialized PRNG streams as independent replications; not a population interval over states
